description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller for managing shopping cart operations, including retrieving, adding, updating, removing items, and clearing the cart.

classes.name: CartController
classes.description: Spring Boot REST controller exposing shopping cart management endpoints.

methods.name: getCurrentUserCart
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve the current user's cart.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add an item to the cart.

methods.name: updateCartItemQuantity
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update the quantity of a cart item.

methods.name: removeFromCart
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an item from the cart.

methods.name: clearCart
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to clear all items from the cart.
